text: {"lessons":["The account has fallen about 8.6% from Period 2 to Period 10, so I should review whether my holdings expose too much of my retirement savings to risk.","A single sale of Stock E did not prevent the later decline; I should assess the whole portfolio rather than rely on one trade to protect its value.","I should avoid reacting to every monthly move, but staying consistent also means reassessing my plan when losses persist and keeping risk appropriate for my needs."]}
